question: In July 2021 who among the following became the Minister of State in the Union Ministry of Panchayati Raj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kapil Moreshwar Patil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• After the reshuffling of the cabinet of Prime Minister Narendra Modi on July 7, 2021, **Shri Kapil Moreshwar Patil **became the Minister of State in the Union Ministry of Panchayati Raj.
 
• Constituency: **Bhiwandi (Maharashtra)**
